description: Portrait of Tille Bode on a portal, sitting in a chair, wearing a flowered collared shirt with an apron, peeling vegetables. Hanging on the adobe wall behind her is a cow skull.  Tille Bode is wife of Martin Bode of  Bode's General Merchandise in Abiquiu. Location could possibly be Ghost Ranch.
title: Tillie Bode
